evidence.quote: p5.4xlarge  16  256 GiB  1 H100  80 GB   HBM3   100 Gbps EFA
GPUDirect RDMA is not supported in P5.4xlarge

notes.zh: 回答单卡云实例的规格，用于小规模微调或单模型部署。两个容易忽略的限制：单卡实例不支持 GPUDirect RDMA，也没有 NVSwitch，想靠多台单卡机拼出多卡训练会卡在通信上；要 8 卡全互联得换 p5.48xlarge。
notes.en: Answers the specification of a single-GPU cloud instance for small fine-tunes or single-model deployment. Two limits are easy to miss: the single-card size supports neither GPUDirect RDMA nor NVSwitch, so stitching several single-GPU hosts into a multi-card training job is communication-bound; eight-card fabric requires the p5.48xlarge size instead.
